place.name: Nevan Plumbing and Heating Services Ltd

reviews.author: its ssj
reviews.text: I recently noticed a sudden dip in my bathroom floor, which caused the toilet to tilt and become completely unstable. I contacted Raj, who immediately assessed the situation via video call and photos before visiting the property at his earliest opportunity to provide an accurate quote. Upon starting the job, Raj arrived strictly on time and ended up rebuilding the entire subfloor to make it safe. Crucially, he discovered and repaired a hidden leak that could have caused severe structural damage to my first-floor flat. The entire project took three days, and the workmanship was exceptional. Throughout the process, Raj maintained excellent communication. He invited me to inspect the progress, listened to my feedback, and executed everything exactly as instructed. His pricing structure is also very transparent. He gave me a clear quote and offered the flexibility to either source the materials myself or have him handle everything. I opted for him to supply the materials, and he managed to fix all the faults to an incredibly high standard within the agreed budget. Thank you, Raj, for your outstanding work and professionalism. I highly recommend his services!

reviews.author: Robert B
reviews.text: Raj is professional, friendly, punctual, and extremely knowledgeable. He explained everything clearly and the standard of work is the highest you will come across. Thanks Raj.

reviews.author: Elies Chemillier
reviews.text: Great service, strongly recommend. They have been helping me with various plumbing issues (boiler parts replacement, underfloor hearing flushing, flush valve replacement, eventually full boiler replacement). The job is always done very professionally and as quickly as possible. They recommend the most economical option while not suggesting any cheap option. Very responsive to messages and calls and very reactive in case of emergency! Great service!

reviews.author: Stephanie De Mel
reviews.text: Raj moved and replaced a couple of my radiators recently, and he was fantastic. He communicated clearly and gave good advice, his work was high-quality and efficient, and he really goes the extra mile to help you get what you need. In addition, he's extremely nice and friendly, which makes him a pleasure to work with. I highly recommend him!

reviews.author: sheikh naghmana
reviews.text:
New gas hob installed by Nevan Plumbing and Heating. Very professional and experienced. Place was left neat and clean.
Highly recommended.

reviews.author: damith nuwan
reviews.text:
Raj recently completed a bathroom job for me, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. From start to finish, he did an excellent job and showed real attention to detail. What stood out most was how he kept me informed throughout the entire process, explaining each stage clearly and making sure I was comfortable with everything being done.

The work was completed to a high standard, on time, and with minimal disruption. I’d highly recommend Raj to anyone looking for a reliable and professional gas engineer.

reviews.author: N Singh
reviews.text:
I was struggling with a broken down heating and hot water system over 2 weeks with my insurance company. So, I contacted Raj, highly recommended to me.
He communicated professionally and gave due consideration to my situation. He also suggested and explained all of my layman queries in the best option to take, that was evidence based after he read the report. I was amazed at his diligence, honesty and methodical work to ensure the heating was functioning again as planned. The job is well done and lower priced compared to mkt, as well.
We finally had a warm home and I was better placed understanding what's happening in my heating system and future steps in it's maintenance and support as well. So, I would highly recommend the services to all. Thanks 👌 😊 so much!

reviews.author: D Leroy
reviews.text:
This is by far the best plumbing service I've ever had. Nevan Plumbing and Heating did an outstanding job on pipe work in our downstairs conservatory toilet. May sound like a simple job but the existing work was old and rotten, he tidied it all up and carefully channeled the pipes into the wall and it looks amazing.

Very polite service, reliable and communicated well. Plan to use them again and certainly recommend them.

reviews.author: Khurram Khan
reviews.text: It appears that the overflow from my cold water tank was connected to the bath overflow, resulting in water leakage. I contacted several plumbers, but they were unable to identify the source of the problem. Fortunately, Yawar from Nevan Plumbing and Heating successfully resolved the issue. Highly recommend. 😃

reviews.author: Jignesh Bhatt
reviews.text: I had my boiler and gas pipe work completed to a high standard. He was professional, punctual, and very reliable. I am pleased with the service and would highly recommend him.
